title: OTHRYS OS project-scoped local chat and work context
goal: Bind controller-local chat drafts to the selected project context so the Panda-style workspace behaves coherently without sending project context anywhere.
laws: Chat drafts remain browser-local and non-executing.
Each project context receives an isolated local draft history.
Switching project context must not merge or leak drafts between contexts.
Canonical othrys-v2 context remains a valid local chat namespace.
New Chat clears only the currently selected context.
No project context or draft is sent to any API, model, Worker or filesystem.

slices.title: Namespace local chat by project context
Prove no chat or context API exists
